description: Mercury retrograde periods overlapping a date range (default: the next 12 months): pre-shadow start, station retrograde, station direct and post-shadow end (to about a minute, in UTC and a chosen time zone), with the degrees and signs of the two stations.

end_date.description: End of the range, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (default: one year after the start). At most 30 years.

start_date.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the range and the local times in the output (default UTC)

name: mercury_retrograde
title: Mercury retrograde
